title: Four regimes, nine orders of magnitude
caption: Power on the horizontal log axis, on-site memory rising vertically. Each tier is the operating regime left over after one wall binds hardest: capacity and energy for TinyML, the power wall for mobile, the light barrier for edge's purpose, the memory wall for cloud.

title: Archetypes: two time terms, two preconditions
caption: Compute- and bandwidth-bound are iron-law terms that set how fast a workload runs. Capacity- and power-bound are feasibility preconditions that decide whether it runs at all. The archetype is a regime, not a model property.

title: Screen, then cost
caption: Four filters ordered by cost of rejection: privacy (a law answers it), latency (one inequality), resource (device specs), then cost (TCO compares only survivors). An empty set means redesign or partition across tiers.
